bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 31-March-2024 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2023 (audited). Income-statement items are for Q1 itself (01 Jan 2024 to 31 Mar 2024; for Q1 the cumulative and discrete-quarter figures are identical). PAT (194,087,067) and EPS (0.24) both match EXACTLY the Q1-2024 comparative column independently printed in this bank's own 2025_Q1.json filing -- strong cross-report consistency. CRITICAL CONTEXT FOR THE FY2024 ASSET-QUALITY EVENT: at 31-Mar-2024, classified loans were still only Tk.5,174.08m (NPL 5.90%) and the loans-and-advances-only provision shortfall (Note 8.10) was only Tk.266.73m -- both barely changed from the 31-Dec-2023 comparative (Tk.5,149.57m classified/5.93% NPL/Tk.355.64m shortfall, matching this bank's already-recorded FY2023 figures exactly). This means essentially ALL of FY2024's dramatic asset-quality deterioration (to NPL 16.17% and a Tk.6,558.39m shortfall by year-end, both already documented in this bank's 2024_Q4.json/sources.json) happened AFTER Q1 -- i.e. within Q2-Q4 2024, not gradually across the whole year. A SECOND, EARLIER regulatory-forbearance episode is disclosed in this filing's own Note 8.10, predating (and much smaller than) the FY2024/FY2025 ones already found in 2025_Q1/Q2/Q3.json: 'The Department of Off-site Supervision of Bangladesh Bank through letter reference no. DOS (CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2024-1836 dated 30 April 2024, approved deferral against the deficit provision of Tk.35.56 crore upto the finalization of financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024. As on March 31, 2024, the proportionate amount of Tk.8.89 crore already provided. The rest amount of Tk.26.67 will be provided within December 31, 2024.' This establishes a pattern of ANNUALLY RECURRING regulatory forbearance letters on this bank's provision shortfall (2024 letter ref ...2024-1836 for a Tk.35.56 crore gap; 2025 letter ref ...2025-3115 for a Tk.1,143.01 crore gap -- a roughly 32x larger shortfall just one year later) -- each deferring the PRIOR year's shortfall into the NEXT reporting cycle rather than requiring immediate recognition, and the gap being deferred grew by roughly 32x between the two instances rather than being resolved as promised. Capital adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosures are not part of this quarterly unaudited financial statement.
